'''Gorm Rons''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[House Ulgo]]'s troops during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He patrolled the [[Ulgo Footpaths]] around and near [[King's Pass]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual in [[3643 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gorm Rons appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on Alderaan. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
